日文.词条标题: 京福電気鉄道デオ600形電車
日文.首段: 京福電気鉄道デオ600形電車（けいふくでんきてつどうデオ600がたでんしゃ）は、京福電気鉄道が1979年から1980年にかけて、デナ500形の下回りを流用して新製した電車（制御電動車）である。車両記号の「デオ」とは、「デ」が電動車を（デンドウシャ）、「オ」が車体の大きさ（大型 = オオガタ）をそれぞれ意味する。1985年の叡山線分社化に際し、叡山電鉄に承継された。

章节.概要:
武庫川車両工業製。デナ500形にはなかった発電制動も装備され、二軒茶屋駅より先の急勾配路線に入線できるようになった。デオ300形の経験から車体長15.0m・全長15.7mに抑えられ、以後の叡電車両の標準となった。車体はデオ300形類似であるがより角ばったものとなり、前面は3枚窓貫通形、側面窓配置はdD5D5Dd（dは乗務員室扉、Dは客用扉、数字は扉間の窓の数）である。正面貫通扉上に2つ並んだ小型のヘッドライトと、屋根上に並んだグローブ型ベンチレーターが特徴である。集電装置は当初よりパンタグラフである。
連結器はそれまでの車両の（並形）自動連結器から密着自動連結器（従来車ともそのまま連結可）に変更され、その後の全営業車に普及している。台車は抱き合わせ型ブレーキ（505 - 510）のものが選ばれており（一時期残ったデナ500形には振り替えて使用）その関係から601 - 604は元阪神881形のU形イコライザーの台車、605・606は元阪神831形の弓形イコライザーの台車を履いている（台車形式は同じ）。
塗色はデオ200形以来の京福京都本社時代の標準色であったクリームと緑のツートンカラーで、叡山電鉄発足後も同塗装で残った最後の旅客車両であった（事業用ではデト1000形が残存）。
大型化されたこともあり当初は主に単行で使用されたが、700系登場以降は番号順（601+602・603+604・605+606）の2両編成で使用されるようになった。なお、その後も単行での使用は考慮されており、1989年（平成元年）のATS取付は全車に実施され、運用離脱まで各車の単独営業運転が可能であった。
章节.廃車:
改造により冷房装置を搭載するよりも新車導入が有利とされ、比較的若い車齢にもかかわらずデオ900系に置き換えられる形で廃車が進んだが、同形式は計画変更で2編成のみで製造が打ち止めとなり、本形式は603+604の2両のみが残存した。ただし、2004年（平成16年）1月13日の原則全列車ワンマン運行化に際してもワンマン機器は搭載されず、定期運用に就くことはなく貸切列車などで使われるのみとなっていた。
その後、最後まで残っていた603+604も2008年（平成20年）11月1日をもって引退することとなり、同日には「さよなら600ラストラン」と題するさよなら運転が行われた。最後の出町柳～二軒茶屋往復運用および最終運転の出町柳発修学院行きには「さよならデオ600形」の装飾が車両の前後に施された。
運用離脱後も修学院車庫で休車のサボを出して留置されていたが、のちに廃車解体された。これにより、旧京福時代から継承した旅客営業車両、および吊り掛け駆動の旅客営業車両は叡山電鉄から消滅し、事業用のデト1000形を除いてカルダン駆動車に統一された。
章节.参考文献:

松原淳「関西地方のローカル私鉄 現況2 京福電気鉄道」『鉄道ピクトリアル』通巻第445号、鉄道図書刊行会、1985年3月、98 - 104頁。 
島本由紀「現有私鉄概説 叡山電鉄」『鉄道ピクトリアル』通巻第685号、鉄道図書刊行会、2000年5月、61 - 66頁。

中文.词条标题: 京福电气铁道デオ600型电力动车组
中文.首段: 京福电气铁道デオ600型电力动车组（けいふくでんきてつどうデオ600がたでんしゃ）是京福电气铁道于1979年至1980年间，流用デナ500型的走行部分新造的电力动车组（控制电动车）。车辆符号“デオ”中，“デ”指电动车（デンドウシャ），“オ”指车体的大小（大型 = オオガタ）。1985年叡山线分社化之际，由叡山电铁承继。

章节.概要:
武库川车辆工业制造。装备了デナ500型所没有的发电制动，从而能够进入二轩茶屋站以远的急坡线路。根据デオ300型的经验，车体长控制在15.0m、全长15.7m，成为此后叡电车辆的标准。车体与デオ300型类似但更为方正，车头为3片窗贯通形，侧面窗配置为dD5D5Dd（d为乘务员室门，D为客用门，数字为门间的窗数）。正面贯通门上方并排的2个小型前照灯，以及车顶上排列的球形通风器是其特征。集电装置自始即为受电弓。
车钩从此前车辆的（并形）自动车钩改为密着自动车钩（可与既有车照样连结），此后普及至全部营业车辆。转向架选用抱合型制动的（505 - 510）（一时残存的デナ500型则改用替换下来的），由于这一关系，601 - 604装用原阪神881型的U形均衡梁转向架，605、606装用原阪神831型的弓形均衡梁转向架（转向架形式相同）。
涂色为デオ200型以来京福京都总公司时代的标准色——奶油色与绿色的双色涂装，也是叡山电铁成立后仍保留该涂装的最后的旅客车辆（业务用则有デト1000型残存）。
由于大型化，当初主要用于单行，但700系登场以后，改为按编号顺序（601+602、603+604、605+606）的2辆编组使用。另外，此后也考虑了单行使用，1989年（平成元年）的ATS安装对全车实施，直到运用脱离为止，各车均可单独营业运行。
章节.报废:
由于改造加装冷气装置不如引进新车有利，尽管车龄相对较新，仍以被デオ900系替换的形式推进报废，但同型因计划变更仅制造2个编组即告中止，本型仅残存603+604的2辆。不过，在2004年（平成16年）1月13日原则上全部列车单人运转化之际，也未搭载单人运转设备，不再进入定期运用，仅在包租列车等中使用。
此后，最后残存的603+604也于2008年（平成20年）11月1日引退，同日举行了题为“再见600最后运行”的告别运行。最后的出町柳～二轩茶屋往返运用以及最终运行的出町柳发往修学院，在车辆前后施加了“再见デオ600型”的装饰。
运用脱离后，在修学院车库挂出休车（停运）的告示牌留置，但后来报废解体。由此，从旧京福时代承继的旅客营业车辆，以及悬吊驱动（吊挂驱动）的旅客营业车辆从叡山电铁消失，除业务用的デト1000型外，统一为卡丹驱动（cardan drive）车。
章节.参考文献:
井上广和・高桥摄《カラーブックス 日本の私鉄24 近畿》保育社，1983年。ISBN 978-4586505982。
松原淳“关西地方的地方私铁 现状2 京福电气铁道”《铁道画刊》总第445号，铁道图书刊行会，1985年3月，98 - 104页。
岛本由纪“现有私铁概说 叡山电铁”《铁道画刊》总第685号，铁道图书刊行会，2000年5月，61 - 66页。

英文.词条标题: Keifuku Electric Railroad Deo 600 series electric car
英文.首段: The Keifuku Electric Railroad Deo 600 series (けいふくでんきてつどうデオ600がたでんしゃ) is an electric car (control motor car) newly built by Keifuku Electric Railroad between 1979 and 1980 using the running gear of the Dena 500 series. In the vehicle code "Deo," "De" means motor car (dendōsha) and "O" means the size of the body (large = ōgata). When the Eizan Line was spun off as a separate company in 1985, it was inherited by Eizan Electric Railway.

章节.Overview:
Made by Mukogawa Sharyo Kogyo. It was equipped with dynamic (rheostatic) braking, which the Dena 500 series lacked, enabling it to enter the steep-gradient section beyond Nikenchaya Station. Based on the experience with the Deo 300 type, the body length was kept to 15.0 m and the overall length to 15.7 m, which became the standard for subsequent Eizan cars. The body is similar to the Deo 300 type but more angular, with a three-window gangway front, and the side window arrangement is dD5D5Dd (d = crew room door, D = passenger door, and the numbers are the number of windows between doors). Its features are two small headlights arranged side by side above the front gangway door and globe-type roof ventilators arranged on the roof. The current collector has been a pantograph from the start.
The coupler was changed from the (parallel-type) automatic coupler of previous cars to a tight-lock automatic coupler (which can still couple directly to existing cars), and this spread to all subsequent revenue cars. The bogies selected were those of the clasp-brake type (505-510) (temporarily transferred for use on the surviving Dena 500 series), and for that reason 601-604 are fitted with bogies with U-shaped equalizers from former Hanshin 881 series cars, while 605 and 606 are fitted with bogies with bow-shaped equalizers from former Hanshin 831 series cars (the bogie type designation is the same).
The livery is the cream-and-green two-tone that had been the standard color since the Deo 200 type in the Keifuku Kyoto head office era, and it was the last passenger car to retain that livery after Eizan Electric Railway was established (the Deto 1000 series survives as a departmental car).
Because it was enlarged, it was mainly used singly at first, but after the 700 series appeared it came to be used in two-car sets in numerical order (601+602, 603+604, 605+606). Note that single-car use was still taken into account thereafter, and the fitting of ATS in 1989 (Heisei 1) was carried out on all cars, so each car could be operated independently in revenue service until withdrawal.
章节.Scrapping:
Because it was judged more advantageous to introduce new cars than to install air-conditioning units through modification, scrapping proceeded in the form of replacement by the Deo 900 series despite the relatively young age of the cars; however, that type was capped at only two sets due to a change of plan, and only two cars of this type, 603+604, survived. However, even when one-man operation of in principle all trains began on January 13, 2004 (Heisei 16), one-man equipment was not fitted, so it never entered scheduled service and was used only on charter trains and the like.
Afterwards, the last surviving 603+604 was to be retired as of November 1, 2008 (Heisei 20), and on that day a farewell run titled "Sayonara 600 Last Run" was held. For the last Demachiyanagi-Nikenchaya round trip and the final run from Demachiyanagi to Shugakuin, decorations reading "Sayonara Deo 600 series" were applied to the front and rear of the car.
Even after withdrawal from service it was stabled at Shugakuin Depot with a "not in service" sign displayed, but it was later scrapped and dismantled. As a result, the passenger revenue cars inherited from the former Keifuku era, as well as the passenger revenue cars with suspended (hanging) drive, disappeared from Eizan Electric Railway, and apart from the departmental Deto 1000 series, the fleet was unified to cardan-drive cars.
章节.References:
Hirokazu Inoue and Setsu Takahashi, "Color Books: Private Railways of Japan 24, Kinki," Hoikusha, 1983. ISBN 978-4586505982.
Jun Matsubara, "Local Private Railways of the Kansai Region, Current Status 2: Keifuku Electric Railroad," "Tetsudō Pictorial" Vol. 445, Tetsudō Tosho Kankōkai, March 1985, pp. 98-104.
Yuki Shimamoto, "Survey of Existing Private Railways: Eizan Electric Railway," "Tetsudō Pictorial" Vol. 685, Tetsudō Tosho Kankōkai, May 2000, pp. 61-66.

When the Eizan Line was spun off as a separate company in 1985, it was inherited by Eizan Electric Railway.

== Overview ==
Made by Mukogawa Sharyo Kogyo. It was equipped with dynamic (rheostatic) braking, which the Dena 500 series lacked, enabling it to enter the steep-gradient section beyond Nikenchaya Station. Based on the experience with the Deo 300 type, the body length was kept to 15.0 m and the overall length to 15.7 m, which became the standard for subsequent Eizan cars. The body is similar to the Deo 300 type but more angular, with a three-window gangway front, and the side window arrangement is dD5D5Dd (d = crew room door, D = passenger door, and the numbers are the number of windows between doors). Its features are two small headlights arranged side by side above the front gangway door and globe-type roof ventilators arranged on the roof. The current collector has been a pantograph from the start.
The coupler was changed from the (parallel-type) automatic coupler of previous cars to a tight-lock automatic coupler (which can still couple directly to existing cars), and this spread to all subsequent revenue cars. The bogies selected were those of the clasp-brake type (505-510) (temporarily transferred for use on the surviving Dena 500 series), and for that reason 601-604 are fitted with bogies with U-shaped equalizers from former Hanshin 881 series cars, while 605 and 606 are fitted with bogies with bow-shaped equalizers from former Hanshin 831 series cars (the bogie type designation is the same).
The livery is the cream-and-green two-tone that had been the standard color since the Deo 200 type in the Keifuku Kyoto head office era, and it was the last passenger car to retain that livery after Eizan Electric Railway was established (the Deto 1000 series survives as a departmental car).
Because it was enlarged, it was mainly used singly at first, but after the 700 series appeared it came to be used in two-car sets in numerical order (601+602, 603+604, 605+606). Note that single-car use was still taken into account thereafter, and the fitting of ATS in 1989 (Heisei 1) was carried out on all cars, so each car could be operated independently in revenue service until withdrawal.

== Scrapping ==
Because it was judged more advantageous to introduce new cars than to install air-conditioning units through modification, scrapping proceeded in the form of replacement by the Deo 900 series despite the relatively young age of the cars; however, that type was capped at only two sets due to a change of plan, and only two cars of this type, 603+604, survived. However, even when one-man operation of in principle all trains began on January 13, 2004 (Heisei 16), one-man equipment was not fitted, so it never entered scheduled service and was used only on charter trains and the like.
Afterwards, the last surviving 603+604 was to be retired as of November 1, 2008 (Heisei 20), and on that day a farewell run titled "Sayonara 600 Last Run" was held. For the last Demachiyanagi-Nikenchaya round trip and the final run from Demachiyanagi to Shugakuin, decorations reading "Sayonara Deo 600 series" were applied to the front and rear of the car.
Even after withdrawal from service it was stabled at Shugakuin Depot with a "not in service" sign displayed, but it was later scrapped and dismantled. As a result, the passenger revenue cars inherited from the former Keifuku era, as well as the passenger revenue cars with suspended (hanging) drive, disappeared from Eizan Electric Railway, and apart from the departmental Deto 1000 series, the fleet was unified to cardan-drive cars.
